app.title: DIVA USM Converter
language.title: Choose your language
language.prompt: Select the language for DIVA USM Converter.
about.title: About DIVA USM Converter
about.body: A desktop utility that extracts VP9 video from CRI USM files and converts it to silent H.264 MP4.
header.title: Convert Project DIVA videos
header.subtitle: Select USM files or a folder. The original files are never changed.
input.label: USM input
output.label: MP4 output folder
profile.label: Encoding profile
profile.help: H.264 / libx264. Project DIVA PV videos have no audio; output MP4 files are silent.
files.heading: Files in this batch
log.title: Activity log
status.ready: Choose input files and an output folder to begin.
status.need_input: Select at least one USM file or folder.
status.batch_running: Conversion is running. You can cancel safely; completed files can be resumed.
status.cancel_requested: Cancellation requested. The current temporary output will be discarded.
dialog.input_folder: Select a folder containing USM files
dialog.output_folder: Select a folder for converted MP4 files
dialog.confirm_cancel.title: Cancel conversion?
dialog.confirm_cancel.body: Stop the current conversion and close the application? Original USM files are safe.
dialog.confirm_cancel_batch.title: Cancel batch?
dialog.confirm_cancel_batch.body: Stop the current file? Completed outputs will remain available for resume.
dialog.error.title: Conversion error
dialog.error.ffmpeg: FFmpeg is missing or could not start. Install FFmpeg with libx264, or place ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe in the application's ffmpeg folder.
dialog.error.wannacri: WannaCRI is missing from this application package. Rebuild the application with its declared dependencies.
dialog.error.encoder: This FFmpeg build does not provide the libx264 encoder.
dialog.error.no_files: The selected folder has no USM files.
dialog.error.output_exists: An output file already exists and was not verified as this source's completed result. It was left untouched: {detail}
dialog.error.cancelled: The conversion was cancelled. The original file is unchanged and the incomplete MP4 was discarded.
dialog.dependencies: Required tools: WannaCRI and FFmpeg with the libx264 encoder. The app checks them before conversion.
report.title: Batch report
